summary: Implementation plan for upgrading NEXUS with Cabinet Grotesk, Inter, and JetBrains Mono editorial typography, Sleek Hardware Lab hairline micro-borders and dual-layer shadows on the pastel frosted glass theme, horizontal 1080p/1440p/4K FPS progress/delta bars across cards and review views, and a live mode switcher to toggle between Option 1 (Full Editorial Lab & Data Viz) and Option 2 (Pure Typography & Micro-Interactions).
